The image shows a single dried, brown, curled mango leaf. The leaf is uniformly brown/tan with no visible spots, lesions, powdery coating, or black sooty deposits. The leaf is curled upward and appears to have dried out and fallen off.

This matches Die_Back symptoms: leaves curl upwards and fall off, with veins turning brown causing upward curling. There are no signs of:
- Anthracnose (no sunken spots, lesions, or halos)
- Powdery Mildew (no white powdery coating)
- Sooty Mould (no black soot-like encrustations)
